dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと兄さん、お時間宜しいでしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Niisan, can I have a moment with you?"
dialogues.text: "Niisan, can I have a moment with you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
昼休み、廊下に出たのを待ち伏せされたかのよ
うに、音夢に行く手を阻まれる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu seemed to be waiting for me to come out into the
hallway at lunchtime.
dialogues.text:
Nemu seemed to be waiting for me to come out into the
hallway at lunchtime.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと付いてきて欲しいんですけど」
dialogues.en: "Could you come with me?"
dialogues.text: "Could you come with me?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What? What?"
dialogues.text: "What? What?"

dialogues.jp:
なにか不機嫌に見えるのだが、なんか怒られる
ようなことをしたか俺？
dialogues.en:
She seemed to be upset with me, but did I do something to
make her upset?
dialogues.text:
She seemed to be upset with me, but did I do something to
make her upset?

dialogues.jp: 思い当たることは多々あるが……。
dialogues.en: I could think of so many things......
dialogues.text: I could think of so many things......

dialogues.jp: ｛や／殺｝るなら杉並のほうが先のような気が。
dialogues.en:
But, I think Suginami would be the one to be assassinated
first.
dialogues.text:
But, I think Suginami would be the one to be assassinated
first.

dialogues.jp: ――まさか既に！？
dialogues.en: Is she going to erase me before him!?
dialogues.text: Is she going to erase me before him!?

dialogues.jp: 「あの、音夢様……なんの御用でしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, what can I do for you, Nemu-sama?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, what can I do for you, Nemu-sama?"

dialogues.jp: とりあえず下手に出てみる。
dialogues.en: I decided to be polite.
dialogues.text: I decided to be polite.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……とりあえず人のいないところで話します」
dialogues.en: "......I'll tell you when nobody's around."
dialogues.text: "......I'll tell you when nobody's around."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「マジか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you serious?"
dialogues.text: "Are you serious?"

dialogues.jp:
拒否できない空気しか漂わせていない音夢の背
中を追いながら、どうやってダイイングメッセー
ジを残すか考えてみた。
dialogues.en:
I thought about how I can leave a dying message as I
followed the angry Nemu.
dialogues.text:
I thought about how I can leave a dying message as I
followed the angry Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
と、言うわけで、その手の場所としては絶好の
屋上に来ております……。
dialogues.en:
Then we ended up on top of the building, the perfect place
for that kind of matter.
dialogues.text:
Then we ended up on top of the building, the perfect place
for that kind of matter.

dialogues.jp:
しかも、よりによって本当に人がいない教員棟
の屋上だよ……今日は萌先輩も眞子もいないみ
たいだし。
dialogues.en:
And it's above the teachers' building, where nobody would be
during lunch time. There's no Moe-sempai or Mako either.
dialogues.text:
And it's above the teachers' building, where nobody would be
during lunch time. There's no Moe-sempai or Mako either.

dialogues.jp:
教員棟は、他の棟よりも１階分高いから、どこ
からも視線が通らない。
dialogues.en:
The teachers' building has an extra floor compared to the
other buildings, so nobody can see us from anywhere.
dialogues.text:
The teachers' building has an extra floor compared to the
other buildings, so nobody can see us from anywhere.

dialogues.jp: 目撃者なし！
dialogues.en: No eyewitnesses!
dialogues.text: No eyewitnesses!

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
音夢も、同じように辺りを見渡して満足げに頷
く。
dialogues.en: Nemu looks around just like me, and nodded happily.
dialogues.text: Nemu looks around just like me, and nodded happily.

dialogues.jp:
「……そうか。うちの家計はそんなに切羽つまっ
　てるのか」
dialogues.en: "......I didn't know we have no money at home."
dialogues.text: "......I didn't know we have no money at home."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いつの間に俺に保険金を……」
dialogues.en: "When did you get life insurance on me?"
dialogues.text: "When did you get life insurance on me?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なにを言ってるんです兄さん？」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、それはむしろ俺の台詞でさ……いった
　いこんなところで何を？」
dialogues.en:
"That's what I want to ask you about...... what are we doing
up here?"
dialogues.text:
"That's what I want to ask you about...... what are we doing
up here?"

dialogues.jp: じーっ、と｛にら／睨｝まれる。
dialogues.en: She glares at me.
dialogues.text: She glares at me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「今、ここで起きることは誰にも言わないよう
　に」
dialogues.en: "Do not tell anyone about this."
dialogues.text: "Do not tell anyone about this."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, sure."
dialogues.text: "Oh, sure."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それと……こほん。今から兄さんに私がする
　ことに他意はないということで……」
dialogues.en:
"And...... well, what I'm doing... I don't have any other
intentions......."
dialogues.text:
"And...... well, what I'm doing... I don't have any other
intentions......."

dialogues.jp: なぜか、ぼそぼそと歯切れ悪く。
dialogues.en: She became less articulate and mumbled.
dialogues.text: She became less articulate and mumbled.

dialogues.jp: 「？　了解」
dialogues.en: "? Fine."
dialogues.text: "? Fine."

dialogues.jp: なんか風向きが変わったような。
dialogues.en: Maybe it was something else.
dialogues.text: Maybe it was something else.

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく目をつぶると、すぐに身体全体に衝
撃が走る――。
dialogues.en:
I closed my eyes for some reason, and I felt a shock to my
body.
dialogues.text:
I closed my eyes for some reason, and I felt a shock to my
body.

dialogues.jp: 走ったが……。
dialogues.en: A shock.......
dialogues.text: A shock.......

dialogues.jp: これは……。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、どうせだから、そのまま目を閉じてて！」
dialogues.en: "Wait, keep your eyes closed like that!"
dialogues.text: "Wait, keep your eyes closed like that!"

dialogues.jp:
身体の前面に妙に柔らかくていい匂いで、あっ
たかい感触を覚えながら呟く。
dialogues.en:
I mumbled as I felt something warm with a nice smell in
front of me.
dialogues.text:
I mumbled as I felt something warm with a nice smell in
front of me.

dialogues.jp: 抱きつかれている……よな。
dialogues.en: Is she hugging me?
dialogues.text: Is she hugging me?

dialogues.jp:
手の置き場に困って、なんだかぱたぱた、と軽
く揺らしてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I didn't know what to do with my hands, and they shook a
little bit.
dialogues.text:
I didn't know what to do with my hands, and they shook a
little bit.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そっか……うん……」
間近の呟きにドキドキする。
dialogues.en: My heart pounded faster to feel her mumble so close to me.
dialogues.text: My heart pounded faster to feel her mumble so close to me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……いいよ」
そっ、と重みが消える。
dialogues.en: And then the weight was gone.
dialogues.text: And then the weight was gone.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「こほん……本当になんでもありませんから」
dialogues.en: "Well...... It's really nothing."
dialogues.text: "Well...... It's really nothing."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや……その……なんでもないってことは」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... well...... what do you mean by nothing?"
dialogues.text: "Ah...... well...... what do you mean by nothing?"

dialogues.jp: ｛ほて／火照｝ってしまった頬をかいて呟く。
dialogues.en: I scratched my cheek as it was flushed.
dialogues.text: I scratched my cheek as it was flushed.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……俺のせいじゃないだろうが」
dialogues.en: "......It's not my fault."
dialogues.text: "......It's not my fault."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんのせいですよ！」
dialogues.en: "It is your fault!"
dialogues.text: "It is your fault!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What!?"
dialogues.text: "What!?"

dialogues.jp: なにか、こんな役得を受けるようなことしたか？
dialogues.en: What did I do to deserve this?
dialogues.text: What did I do to deserve this?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あの……さくらが兄さんに抱きついたときの
　顔が気持ちよさそうなんだもん……」
dialogues.en: "Well...... you looked really happy when Sakura hugged you."
dialogues.text: "Well...... you looked really happy when Sakura hugged you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いいの！　記憶から抹消しなさい！！」
dialogues.en: "So, that's it! Erase it from your memory!!"
dialogues.text: "So, that's it! Erase it from your memory!!"

dialogues.jp:
叫んで、音夢がドシドシと扉をあけて屋上から
出ていってしまう。
dialogues.en: She yelled and opened the door loud and left.
dialogues.text: She yelled and opened the door loud and left.

dialogues.jp:
ため息をついて、いまだ驚いている胸を押さえ
る。
dialogues.en: I sighed and touched my heart which was still pounding fast.
dialogues.text: I sighed and touched my heart which was still pounding fast.

dialogues.en: "What a pain......"
dialogues.text: "What a pain......"

dialogues.jp: なんとな〜く。
dialogues.en: Kind of......
dialogues.text: Kind of......

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく、気持ちよかったかどうかだけ聞き
たかったかな、なんて思った。
dialogues.en:
I thought maybe I should have asked her if she felt good or
not.
dialogues.text:
I thought maybe I should have asked her if she felt good or
not.

dialogues.jp: そんな青空。
dialogues.en: The sky was so blue.
dialogues.text: The sky was so blue.

dialogues.jp: ◆抱き心地◆
dialogues.en: ◆How she felt in my arms◆
dialogues.text: ◆How she felt in my arms◆

dialogues.jp:
問答無用な雰囲気の音夢に連れられて、屋上へ
と来た俺。
dialogues.en: Nemu dragged me off without saying a word.
dialogues.text: Nemu dragged me off without saying a word.

dialogues.jp:
保険金殺人と思いきや、なぜか音夢に抱きしめ
られてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I thought she was going to kill me for my life insurance,
but instead, she gave me a hug.
dialogues.text:
I thought she was going to kill me for my life insurance,
but instead, she gave me a hug.

dialogues.jp:
俺に抱きついているときのさくらの顔が気持ち
よさそうだったから――だそうだ。
dialogues.en:
And the reason for the hug was because I looked happy when
Sakura gave me a hug.
dialogues.text:
And the reason for the hug was because I looked happy when
Sakura gave me a hug.
